concept: Send a large early SCV group across the map after a very short setup, use worker focus fire and repairs to win the first base fight, and add Marines only as a follow-up.
rules: Check emergency_defence first, then worker_assault. Otherwise use opening, worker_assault, marine_followup.
Start the worker attack at the early timing with up to eleven SCVs. Keep the main group compact and avoid isolated trades.
When an attacking SCV is below about 40 percent health, move it into the repair group; return it to combat when healthy enough or too few workers remain to sustain repairs.
This tactic is all-in in spirit: do not delay the attack for standard macro, technology, or expansion.

enter_when: The early SCV attack group has not yet been sent.
phases.goal: Reach the worker attack timing immediately.
guidance: Train three SCVs immediately and prepare to pull the attack group at the early timing.
Do not wait for normal production structures before moving out.

enter_when: The SCV group is moving toward the enemy or fighting at the enemy base.
phases.goal: Break the worker line through grouped focus fire and repair cycling.
guidance: Send up to eleven SCVs as one group toward the attack target and briefly compact them with nearby minerals if needed.
Focus exposed workers and weak early units.
If an enemy ramp is walled, seek workers or openings instead of wasting the group on the wall.
Keep low-health SCVs behind the healthy frontline for repair.

enter_when: The worker fight is ongoing or has created an opening.
Marines are available to reinforce it.
phases.goal: Extend worker pressure with basic ranged support.
guidance: Send new Marines toward the same attack target.
Use Marines to pressure workers and production while SCVs repair, tank damage, or retreat.
Regroup small survivors rather than walking them alone into a stronger enemy army.

enter_when: The enemy counterattacks the main base and immediate loss is possible.
phases.goal: Prevent defeat while retaining as much attack pressure as possible.
guidance: Return only enough workers and Marines to stop immediate loss.
If the worker assault has failed, prioritize survival rather than feeding more units.
